persons.name: Bora Özkent
persons.digest:
In yesterday's bulletin Bora Özkent says US stocks keep setting records, the S&P 500 hit an all-time high and the market has risen 45 days straight; a short breather wouldn't surprise him but he is still a bull. He advises ignoring crash prophets like Michael Burry and Ray Dalio, arguing that crash calls with bad timing only make you miss opportunities. Today's FOMC minutes and two Fed speakers could cause a dip, but the earnings growth of the Mag 7 carrying the rally is real.

In energy, Google's 20-year deal with **Constellation** for capacity increases at 11 reactors lifted **Constellation** 12.25% and **Vistra** 10.77% yesterday; he finds both cheap but doesn't see the move as lasting since there are no new reactors, and prefers **Bloom Energy**, which creates new supply. He sees **Axon** and **Ondas** as opportunities in data center security, finds the sell-off in memory stocks absurd and still considers **Micron** cheap. **Marvell** raised its revenue targets after its investor day and the stock rose about 6%; he ties the borrowing needs of **SpaceX** ($40B) and **Broadcom** ($60B) to AI investment's hunger for capital. Finally he relays OpenAI's results on more than 300 math problems and the thesis that AI labs may shift toward biotech.

items.title: Nasdaq Rallisine Mola mı Geliyor?
items.summary: Bora Özkent reports that the S&P 500 and Nasdaq set new records, the 10-year yield fell 4 bps and the 2-year 5 bps, and the dollar stayed strong. He says today's FOMC minutes and Fed speeches could cause a short dip, and that oil stocks and the diesel shortage are spooking the market. He advises ignoring crash prophets (Michael Burry, Ray Dalio); S&P 500 earnings growth is expected at 27%, 68% of it from the top 10 tech-heavy companies. The Google–Constellation 20-year deal lifted energy: Constellation +12.25%, Vistra +10.77%, but with no new reactors he prefers new-supply players like Bloom Energy. With attacks on data centers and negative propaganda, he sees Axon and Ondas as security opportunities. He finds the memory sell-off absurd, reminds that Micron says it is sold out through 2030, and is happy with Marvell raising revenue targets after its investor day. SpaceX is seeking $40B, Broadcom $60B and Waymo $5B (at 5.25%); he thinks this strains Treasury markets but that autonomous driving will pay back fast. For a rotation he points to XLU's rise, but he himself prefers staying in AI or in cash. Bottom line: bullish, though a short pause in the rally would be healthy.

holdings.name: SoFi Technologies

mentions.quote: There's no problem in the company's fundamentals. The only issue is the high-rate environment. I personally keep accumulating.

holdings.why: Per cevikfinance fundamentals are fine, the only issue is high rates and he keeps accumulating; he gave no level or date.
holdings.opinion: Over a fifth of the portfolio sits in one stock; with the 10-year yield at 5.28-5.36% in the sources, rate sensitivity is this position's main risk. A single positive source view doesn't justify the weight.
ai_points: For: cevikfinance sees no fundamental problem and keeps accumulating.
Against: the weight is about 21% and, in cevikfinance's own words, high rates are the one problem.
Against: in today's sources the 10-year yield rose as high as 5.36%.

holdings.name: Meta Platforms A

mentions.quote: Meta secured a $27 billion financing deal with a Blue Owl Capital-led consortium for the Hyperion AI data center being built in Louisiana.
Meta was up.

holdings.why: Per WallStDiaries Meta closed the $27B Hyperion financing with Blue Owl; there is no level or date for buying or selling.
holdings.opinion: Moving infrastructure costs off the balance sheet via leasing eases spending pressure but makes commitments long-term. It is 14.75% of the portfolio and tied to the same AI-spend theme as Broadcom.
ai_points: For: the Hyperion financing manages AI infrastructure off-balance-sheet and lightens the capital load.
Against: today's sources contain no concrete buy or sell rationale for Meta.
Against: together with Broadcom about 29% of the portfolio is tied to AI spending.

holdings.name: Broadcom

mentions.quote: BROADCOM SEEKS $50B+ IN FINANCING FOR OPENAI’S CUSTOM AI CHIPS: WSJ
We talked about Broadcom yesterday, seeking $60 billion.

holdings.why: wallstengine, citing the WSJ, reported Broadcom is seeking $50B+ in financing for OpenAI chips; talks are early and there's no buy-sell rationale.
holdings.opinion: The financing search shows how big OpenAI's demand is, but Broadcom's indirect tie to customer financing adds risk. Watch whether a deal firms up before year-end.
ai_points: For: the 10 GW custom chip partnership with OpenAI points to deployments running through 2029.
Against: the financing is at an early stage and the amount could change (WSJ).
Against: about 14% of the portfolio rides on a theme dependent on a single customer.

holdings.name: BWX Technologies
holdings.opinion: No direct information in today's sources; Bora Özkent's energy-bottleneck narrative (uprates at existing reactors) relates indirectly to the nuclear theme but is not a signal for this stock.
ai_points: For: at 11% of the portfolio it is a balancing weight on the defense/nuclear side.
Against: no source addressed this stock directly today, so no new rationale emerged.

holdings.name: Reddit A
holdings.opinion: Nothing on Reddit in the sources. About 9.6% of the portfolio with an ad-based model; sensitive to the broader breadth risk such as korkmazali08's warning about weakness in growth stocks.
ai_points: For: no negative news on the stock today.
Against: per korkmazali08 weakness in smaller growth stocks continues; such names could be affected.

holdings.name: iShares USD Treasury Bond 20+yr EUR Hedged (Dist)
holdings.opinion: Nothing directly on this ETF in the sources, but a 10-year yield at 5.28-5.36% means pressure on long-dated bond prices. Today's 30-year auction could set the direction.
ai_points: For: the 10-year auction drew strong demand and the yield eased from 5.36% to 5.28% (WallStDiaries).
Against: energy prices, inflation worries and bond supply keep upward pressure on yields.
Against: the 30-year auction is today; it is the real test for long-dated paper.

holdings.name: Amundi MSCI Turkey (Acc)

mentions.quote: BIST stocks will be affected more than you think.
I can't understand why the SPK still doesn't abolish the floor/ceiling limits.

holdings.why: Per dtfinans_ the PPF crisis will hit BIST stocks harder than expected, but this retail comment includes no level or date.
holdings.opinion: On a day when BIST100 fell 2.35% intraday (as quoted by dtfinans_), the fund crisis and weakened deposit confidence could tighten local liquidity. Weight is 6.8%; currency effects should be watched separately.
ai_points: Against: dtfinans_ says the PPF crisis dries up private-sector credit and will hit BIST.
Against: falls of astor -8%, asels -5%, tralt -4% in BIST30 were relayed.
For: it is only a one-day drop; the sources give no level or date to justify selling.

holdings.name: FORGENT POWER SOLUTIONS INC.
holdings.opinion: No direct information in the sources. The power infrastructure theme was in focus today via the Google–Constellation deal and Bora Özkent's energy narrative; at a 4.5% weight, single-stock volatility has a limited portfolio impact.

Against: no source addressed the stock directly, so no new rationale emerged.
